text.en:
The National Economic and Development Authority and the Ministry of Human Settlements
shall undertake further studies on the feasibility of extending or lifting rent control and submit their
recommendations to the Batasang Pambansa not later than September 15, 1984. For the purpose, both
agencies are hereby authorized to solicit all necessary data/information from both public and private
institutions.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done this 29th day of March, 1984.
